governing_goal: Adopt the user-provided deep-task protocol as an actual UAOS execution contract for explicit depth requests and materially deep tasks, without creating a second cognition state machine.
production_result: UAOS 2.8.0 preserves DELIBERATION_POLICY as the sole cognition-stage owner and adds config/DEEP_TASK_EXECUTION_PROFILE.json as an evidence-admission profile rather than a second state machine.

DeepTaskSignals + assess_deep_task_requirement derive activation semantically; explicit user depth always activates the profile, while non-explicit material escalation requires evidence that the ordinary STRUCTURED floor is insufficient.

DeepTaskCase + require_deep_task_admission require governing outcome, externally grounded professional-practice gap, primary/raw material, concrete methods/tools, unknown discovery, competing alternatives/falsification, independent judge, holdout/replay/realistic-runtime/production validation, acceptance criteria and feasibility evidence for any stretch target.

Controlled finalization recomputes deep-task activation from supplied semantic signals and blocks completion when the required DeepTaskCase is absent; a false compatibility boolean cannot cancel a true semantic trigger.
Independent judge evidence is limited to tool/test/runtime/scenario evidence; same-model analysis and static repository facts cannot serve as the judge.
ENTRYPOINT, AGENTS, SYSTEM_MAP, COMMON_CAPABILITIES and CURRENT_SYSTEM point to the same deep-task profile/admission/finalization architecture.

verification.production_reread: UAOS 2.8.0 and DEEP_TASK_EXECUTION_PROFILE present on main

remaining_boundaries: Native ChatGPT has no verified repository-controlled pre-send/pre-tool hook or guaranteed semantic-signal injector; physical non-bypassable enforcement is not claimed there.
Registered child operational enforcement is not claimed until each child provides owner-native invocation evidence for the inherited profile.
next_action: Production observation only. Reopen through a new evolution transaction if real-use evidence shows trigger, evidence-admission or host-integration drift.
